requirements: Read the entire packet, all 1241 scoped indexed transcript lines, and validator lines 1–461 literally in bounded untruncated output before drafting. Report read ranges to the controller and WAIT for release before any draft.

Inventory only. No ratings, totals, critiques, rhetorical tags, winner, outside research, other debates, Git history, credentials, paid calls or other agent contexts. One initial inventory attempt. Use API-key-free shell commands.

Freeze exactly the supplied motion and side identities. Wilson argues Christian theism grounds truth, goodness, beauty and rationality; Hitchens proposes secular inquiry/cultural value and challenges theistic inferences. Do not assign the critic an unadopted burden of a complete naturalistic explanation.

The full event was screened by the controller; the eligible excerpt is the complete source for this assessment. Do not consult excluded introduction, Q&A, closings or replay. Caption errors are not argument defects. Mark meaningful wording/attribution uncertainty medium or low and explain the audio need, never claim audio was heard.

Select source-led 4–7 semantic sections weighted to 100 and 8–48 moves, with at most four per side per section. Three rows are ordinary; every fourth requires explicit independently complete, nonmergeable argument rationale. Do not manufacture balance or drop material content.
Each side needs 3–7 burden bridges with exactly one motion bridge, at least one central and one subsidiary. Importance 1–3 and weights must be source-relevance based, never predictions of strength.

Use original eventIndex values, not scoped array positions. A selected source passage must consist of contiguous original indices, wholly inside the approved scope and outside the replay. Keep the smallest complete claim-and-reason passage; target 30–90 words and at most 2200 characters unless source-specific necessity is explained. Avoid substantive opponent interjections inside a claimed single-speaker span.

Replies link to earlier selected moves; components identify the particular claim answered. Coverage audit must account for every substantive eligible phase, repetition, concession and omission without using unseen excluded content.

Provide independent selectionBalanceAudit and publicationCapacityAudit, with exact recomputable side counts, thresholds 3 total/2 section for balance explanation, and all fourth-row rationales. The controller will independently recompute and validate everything before locking.

Draft parts only: routes, sections, moves, coverageAudit, speakerAttributionReview, audits and scope objects. Each move includes moveId, side, speaker, sectionId, moveKind, claim, warrant, inference, startEvent, endEvent, quoteEligibleExactSpans (exact 3–18-word strings), attributionConfidence, attributionRationale, audioVerificationReason, importance, importanceRationale, burdenContact (bridgeId,tier,rationale), respondsToIds, responseComponents (targetMoveId,component,rationale). Controller materializes the exact sourceSpan.
Use apply_patch for authorized files. Do not write inventory.json; controller assembles after independent source and capacity checks. Do not import other model work or produce scores.
